set -euo pipefail; cd projects/kobra2-neo; PLOTTER="$HOME/.local/share/plotter-tools/plottter/.venv/bin/plottter"; test -x "$PLOTTER"; uv sync --frozen >/dev/null; BASE="$HOME/Desktop/kamienna110-map-beauty-150"; PROFILE="${BASE}-profile.toml"; test -s "$PROFILE"; RAW="${BASE}-balanced-raw.svg"; rm -f "$RAW"; "$PLOTTER" --generator Map --preset "Full City" --paper Custom --width 150 --height 150 --margin 7 --param 'location=Kamienna 110, Wroclaw, Poland' --param radius_km=0.55 --param extent_mode=radius --param road_detail=standard --param include_roads=true --param include_rail=true --param include_water=true --param include_waterways=true --param include_parks=true --param include_buildings=true --param include_coastline=false --param area_fill=none --param major_road_strokes=1 --param simplify_mm=0.16 --param min_feature_mm=1.0 --param include_attribution=false --param include_water_labels=false --param include_park_labels=false --param include_place_labels=false --param include_waterway_labels=false --param include_road_labels=false --format svg --no-registration-marks --output "$RAW"; test -s "$RAW"; uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import copy, math, re, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
base=Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-beauty-150"
raw=Path(f'{base}-balanced-raw.svg')
ET.register_namespace('', 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg')
ET.register_namespace('inkscape', 'http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape')
ns='{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}'
ink='{http://www.inkscape.org/namespaces/inkscape}'
orig=ET.parse(raw)
root0=orig.getroot()
def pts(s):
    out=[]
    for chunk in re.split(r'\s+', (s or '').strip()):
        if not chunk: continue
        try:
            x,y=chunk.split(','); out.append((float(x),float(y)))
        except Exception: pass
    return out
def size_mm(el):
    ps=pts(el.get('points',''))
    if not ps: return 999.0
    xs=[p[0] for p in ps]; ys=[p[1] for p in ps]
    return max(max(xs)-min(xs), max(ys)-min(ys))
for threshold in (1.4,2.0,2.6):
    root=copy.deepcopy(root0)
    bgroups=[]
    for g in root.iter(ns+'g'):
        ident=(g.get('id','')+' '+g.get(ink+'label','')).lower()
        if 'building' in ident:
            bgroups.append(g)
    before=after=0
    for g in bgroups:
        for parent in list(g.iter()):
            for child in list(parent):
                if child.tag in (ns+'polyline',ns+'polygon'):
                    before+=1
                    if size_mm(child) < threshold:
                        parent.remove(child)
                    else:
                        after+=1
    out=Path(f'{base}-balanced-b{str(threshold).replace(".","p")}.svg')
    ET.ElementTree(root).write(out,encoding='utf-8',xml_declaration=True)
    print(f'FILTER threshold={threshold} building_groups={len(bgroups)} building_polylines_before={before} kept={after} removed={before-after} out={out}')
PY
for T in 1p4 2p0 2p6; do SVG="${BASE}-balanced-b${T}.svg"; JOB="${BASE}-balanced-b${T}.job"; if [ -d "$JOB" ]; then test -f "$JOB/.kobra-plot-job" && rm -rf "$JOB" || { echo "REFUSING_UNMARKED_JOB:$JOB"; exit 40; }; fi; uv run kobra-plot prepare "$SVG" --profile "$PROFILE" -o "$JOB"; done; uv run python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, shutil, hashlib
base=Path.home()/"Desktop/kamienna110-map-beauty-150"
cands=[]
for threshold,tag in [(1.4,'1p4'),(2.0,'2p0'),(2.6,'2p6')]:
    job=Path(f'{base}-balanced-b{tag}.job')
    rep=json.loads((job/'report.json').read_text())
    g=rep['geometry']; s=rep['safety']
    if not s.get('valid'): raise SystemExit(f'safety failed {tag}')
    c={'threshold_mm':threshold,'tag':tag,'job':job,'time':float(g['nominal_time_seconds']),'polylines':int(g['polylines']),'points':int(g['points']),'draw':float(g['draw_distance_mm']),'travel':float(g['travel_distance_mm']),'bounds':g['output_bounds']}
    cands.append(c); print('CANDIDATE',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in c.items() if k!='job'},sort_keys=True))
feasible=[c for c in cands if c['time']<=3900 and c['polylines']<=1600]
chosen=min(feasible,key=lambda c:c['threshold_mm']) if feasible else min(cands,key=lambda c:c['time'])
print('CHOSEN',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in chosen.items() if k!='job'},sort_keys=True))
job=chosen['job']; tag=chosen['tag']
for srcname,dst in [('output.gcode',f'{base}-kobra.gcode'),('preview.svg',f'{base}-kobra-preview.svg'),('report.json',f'{base}-kobra-report.json')]: shutil.copy2(job/srcname,Path(dst))
shutil.copy2(Path(f'{base}-balanced-b{tag}.svg'),Path(f'{base}.svg'))
sel={'selected_radius_km':0.55,'building_min_dimension_mm':chosen['threshold_mm'],'road_detail':'standard','features':['roads','rail','water','waterways','parks','buildings'],'selection_reason':'maximum retained building detail within bounded lift-heavy runtime when possible','geometry':{k:v for k,v in chosen.items() if k not in {'job','tag'}},'gcode_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(f'{base}-kobra.gcode').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
Path(f'{base}-selection.json').write_text(json.dumps(sel,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n'); print('FINAL_SELECTION',json.dumps(sel,sort_keys=True))
PY
FINAL_G="${BASE}-kobra.gcode"; FINAL_R="${BASE}-kobra-report.json"; SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$FINAL_G" | awk '{print $1}'); echo "FINAL_SHA256=$SHA"; uv run kobra-live "$FINAL_G" --report "$FINAL_R" --profile "$PROFILE" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --validate-only; PORT=$(uv run python - <<'PY'
import glob
from kobra_live import PosixSerial,_identify
for p in sorted(glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbserial-*')):
    try:
        with PosixSerial(p) as s: _identify(s)
        print(p); break
    except Exception: pass
PY
); test -n "$PORT"; echo "KOBRA_PORT=$PORT"; set +e; uv run kobra-live "$FINAL_G" --report "$FINAL_R" --profile "$PROFILE" --port "$PORT" --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --progress-every 100 --thermal-check-every 250 > "${BASE}-live.log" 2>&1; RC=$?; set -e; cat "${BASE}-live.log"; if [ "$RC" -eq 0 ]; then echo RESULT:PRINT_COMPLETED; elif grep -q 'hotend thermal monitor implausible' "${BASE}-live.log"; then echo RESULT:PRINT_BLOCKED_THERMISTOR_BEFORE_MOTION; else echo "RESULT:PRINT_FAILED_UNEXPECTED rc=$RC"; exit "$RC"; fi; ls -lh "${BASE}.svg" "$FINAL_G" "${BASE}-kobra-preview.svg" "$FINAL_R" "$PROFILE" "${BASE}-selection.json"; echo BEAUTY_MAP_BALANCED_FLOW_DONE
